title: datamodels.jp catalog index
description: Wire format of catalog.json, the machine-readable index of every model, read by brokers, tools and agents. Within a formatVersion fields are only added, never removed or retyped, so consumers must ignore unknown fields and this schema does not forbid them. formatVersion 1 is the format published at the launch on datamodels.jp; the pre-release index at models.geonicdb.com is not continued.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the licence of catalog.json and of every file it lists (schemas, contexts, vocabularies, examples, mapping files, adapter files): CC0-1.0. The prose of the pages is CC BY 4.0; see licenseUrl.

licenseUrl.description: The licence terms of the catalog files and pages.

pageUrl.description: The model page in Japanese, the root locale of the site.

pageUrlEn.description: The same model page in English.

exampleUrls.description: The example files of the model: example.json (key-values) and, for an entity type, example-normalized.jsonld (NGSI-LD normalized, with @context).

mappingUrls.description: The mapping files of the model (YAML): field-by-field correspondence to other standards and, where present, the rules a converter uses to turn a published list into this model. They are not versioned: the URL stays, the content follows the model's current version. Absent when the model has no mapping.

mappings.description: The mapping files of the model with the standard each one maps (its name in Japanese and English), so a tool can show them without fetching the files. Same files as mappingUrls. Absent when the model has no mapping.

attributes.description: A summary of the model's attributes, so a tool can list them or match a CSV against several models without fetching every schema. The schema at schemaUrl stays the authority: conditional rules (anyOf, oneOf), lengths and ranges are only there. `required` is the schema's top-level required list. A value type (JapaneseAddress, Geometry) has type object and its IRI in valueModel; a relationship names its target type in target.

type.description: JSON Schema type of the key-values value

items.description: For an array: the type, format and allowed values of its items

valueModel.description: IRI of the value type, for an attribute whose value is a catalog value type

target.description: For a relationship: the target type's IRI, or a word such as agent when several types are allowed

multi.description: A multi-valued attribute: an array in key-values, one instance per value in normalized form

kind.description: entity: an NGSI-LD entity type; value: a reusable value structure referenced from entity schemas. Absent means entity.

aliasOf.description: Present when this type is another name for a type defined elsewhere in the catalog: same IRI, same attributes. typeIri equals aliasOf.

subClassOf.description: Present when this type is a subclass of another catalog type: own IRI, attributes with the same name share the parent IRIs, parent required attributes stay required.

adapters.description: Files generated for a particular broker or tool, keyed by adapter name (for example geonicdb: a Custom Data Model request body). Absent when no adapter produces a file for the model.

vocabularyUrl.description: The subject's RDFS vocabulary (classes, rdfs:subClassOf, labels) at this exact version.
